title: Rampart deployment diagram
description: How Rampart runs: one Cloudflare Worker with static assets and no database. The browser runs the whole game; the Worker checks the sign-in and serves the files.

nodes.name: Player's browser
nodes.description: Runs the Godot web export (WebGL 2, single-threaded) and keeps the high score.

nodes.name: Cloudflare edge
nodes.description: Runs the Worker on icelander.net/games/retro/rampart*, ahead of the games hub's less specific route icelander.net/games/*.

nodes.name: rampart Worker
nodes.description: worker/index.ts: the signed-in game page and the joined engine file; every other path is a static asset from ./dist.

nodes.name: Games hub
nodes.description: The games hub at icelander.net/games (the recreations repository's Worker): sign-in on this host (/auth/…) and play time (/play.js).

nodes.name: icelander.net login service
nodes.description: accounts.icelander.net, in the icelander.net repository (accounts/): who holds the host's site_session cookie and their games: roles. The Worker reaches it only through a service binding.

artifacts.name: Godot web export
artifacts.description: index.html, index.js, index.pck, the audio worklets and index.wasm in 20 MiB parts (Cloudflare serves files of at most 25 MiB).

artifacts.name: boot.js, shell.css and _headers
artifacts.description: The boot script (esbuild bundle), stylesheet, favicon and a strict Content-Security-Policy.

artifacts.name: Worker script
artifacts.description: The fetch handler, bundled by wrangler.

relationships.description: HTTPS: the page and its files.
Service binding ACCOUNTS (entrypoint Internal): the game's page needs a signed-in player.
